svg.title: IBM Verify in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for IBM Verify: nine products in the Verify family; five standards IBM names for Verify, SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS; modern authentication extended to legacy apps without code changes. Each figure is IBM's, from its IBM Verify page. IBM states no test conditions for them.
